title.en: NASA’s rover beat a nearly 15-year driving record in five-and-a-half years. Who was steering?
title.zh: NASA火星车五年半跑赢前辈近十五年，谁在掌方向盘？

summary.en: Perseverance passed 45.22km; NASA credits AutoNav, with humans choosing waypoints. More reach means more science, not proof of life or limitless autonomy.
summary.zh: 毅力号累计45.22公里，NASA归功于AutoNav，但航点仍由人选择。行得更远不等于发现生命或无限自治。

title.en: Microsoft followed scam messages—and found the shops supplying them.
title.zh: 微软追查诈骗短信，追到了骗子的供货商。

summary.en: Microsoft reports action against services behind over 1 billion malicious messages. Blocking domains is not the same as eliminating fraud.
summary.zh: 微软披露打击支撑逾十亿条恶意消息的服务商；封域名不等于诈骗绝迹。
